name: autopilot
description: Multi-agent orchestrator harness for Claude Code: command loop, ledger, dispatch protocol, review cycle, model-economics, and a registry-driven external-worker layer.

enforcement.title: Enforcement mode
enforcement.description: Enforcement posture for Autopilot's hooks. off = no enforcement (the /ledger view still works); advisory = ask before catastrophic Bash commands, warn the model about briefs without acceptance criteria, and hide security-engineer from a Fable session; strict = deny those Bash commands and criteria-less briefs, hide security-engineer from Fable, and refuse spawns from inside an autopilot role.
